title: vscode-github-copilot-chat hook stdout contract
description: Seam 4 of the adapter's invocation plumbing: the host decision JSON the harness hook command prints on stdout (exit 0) for VS Code's hook engine to honor. Exit 2 (stderr to model, action blocked) remains only the hard-failure fallback; every deliberate decision uses these shapes. Empty stdout on exit 0 is a valid passthrough (no decision, no context) and is NOT governed by this contract. Grounded in extensions/copilot/src/platform/chat/common/chatHookService.ts (per-event outputs) and .../extension/chat/vscode-node/chatHookService.ts (collapsing, hookEventName compatibility) in microsoft/vscode.

continue.description: Common host field: plain success/continue signal.

stopReason.description: Common host field: short-circuits remaining hooks of the same event. The adapter never sets it (single registration per event).

systemMessage.description: Common host field: user-visible warning. The adapter's harness-error reporting surface on inject-only boundaries (H0, H1).

plainCommon.description: Common-fields-only output — H5/H6 valid/pass results, H0/H1 harness-error reporting (systemMessage), telemetry acknowledgments.

promptSubmitDecision.description: H0 out — session-started context injection. The adapter never uses UserPromptSubmit's decision:block (this boundary must not veto the user's message).

additionalContext.description: The rendered workflow context: inlined instruction contents + skill load directives, built from the WorkflowInstructionsReport/WorkflowSkillsReport per H0's output construction. Injected as plain prompt text into the current request only.

The rendered step context: inlined instruction contents + skill load directives, built from the StepInstructionsReport/StepSkillsReport per H1's output construction. Rendered into the subagent's first user message, this request only.

preToolUseDecision.description: H2/H3/H4 out — permission decision (deny maps any non-pass/allowed harness outcome, including harness errors: deny-by-default). H4 answers an agent's harness request with a deny whose reason is the hook-run report ('SAFe agentic harness RESULT …') or the rejection ('SAFe agentic harness REJECTED …'). Never updatedInput: no adapter edits an agent's tool input.

permissionDecision.description: The host also accepts 'ask'; the adapter never emits it — the harness decides, it does not defer to the user mid-boundary.

permissionDecisionReason.description: On deny: the serialized report content (condition checks with failure messages / authorization failureMessage / harness error detail), or H4's RESULT/REJECTED text. Relayed to the model as the tool result 'Tool execution denied: <reason>'.

additionalContext.description: Appended to the tool result as a <PreToolUse-context> tag — even on deny. H4 uses it to tell the agent the denial is the harness's answer.

postToolUseDecision.description: H5/H6 out — negative outcomes only (reverted write / failed postconditions / harness error). Positive outcomes use plainCommon.

reason.description: H5: artifactCheck.failureMessage + revert record, verbatim. H6: serialized conditionChecks. Fed back to the model.

additionalContext.description: Appended to the tool result as a <PostToolUse-context> tag (e.g. the retry/re-resolution directive).
